Together with Kid-E-Cats and other characters of the famous animated series we’ll build a real house for a family of cats. All your building skills will definitely come in handy for us. A great range of building vehicles and fantastic ideas!:)

Educational games with kittens and vehicles for toddlers train memory, fine motor skills and communication skills.
Let's help your favorite heroes build their own home! In the game we will go through all the stages of construction with both adult cats and kitty cats. Everyone will get a task that fits the skills!

To build the House for Kid-E-Cats we need construction vehicles: bulldozer, crane, truck and others!

Let's dive into the process of building a house! Miu-miu-miu!

Together with Kid-E-Cats we’ll assemble cars out of  puzzles, refuel the vehicles and rush to the race!

Each level of the game has its own puzzles and its own car, its own races and tasks for getting more and more resources.

The house will grow from the foundation to the roof really fast provided we:

-clear a site to build a house
-drive the piles
-pour the concrete foundation
-lay pipes
-install a fireplace, a chimney and a brick house foundation
-put the roof on
-install and paint the windows
-plant trees and bushes
-and also…build a large playground for Kid-E-Cats!

Assembling puzzles, swiping while washing and tapping while playing perfectly develop fine motor skills and kids’ attention.
Kid-E-Cats are now known not only for casting in the animated series but also for featuring as nice helpers in the educational children's game!

Cool construction equipment which helps to recreate almost realistic building construction and action-packed mini-games make everyone get involved into carefree playing!

Boys and girls, humans and cats - we’ll build a House for Kid-E-Cats!
